pending_product_gates.requirement: Two independent users complete all three journeys without developer intervention; record completion, errors and time.
Establish and approve p50/p95 baselines for editor input, Jobs switching, circuit inspection and reconnect on a recorded reference machine. No response-time claim without measurements.
Verify long sessions, large circuits, large result histories, keyboard navigation and a narrow viewport with recorded fixtures and limits.
Separately authorize and evaluate real model task quality and cost; scripted protocol acceptance does not establish model intelligence.
Provide and verify a draft-safe workspace JSON backup import before claiming complete workspace backup round trips. Download currently supports manual recovery.
